observes: AUDITB journal footprints of ledger writers (pid-filtered, journal.transactions): enable genesis writes ^IVG.Ledger, ledger_revisions, ledger_stats in one transaction; node-op, create_rel, set_qual, delete_rel+detach commits write ^IVG.Ledger, governed tables, ^KG (and ^NKG) in one outermost transaction; only $Increment counters (^KG(__version), ^KG(gen), ^NKG($meta,...), ^NKG(-3,..)), row-id counters and rdf_props index 7 'W' nodes are non-transactional; a stale-head refusal writes nothing but ledger_stats, in Bump's own transaction after the commit's rollback. Declared stores = observed stores.
